newsitem.title: CHINA: World trade chief wants credible China proposal.
newsitem.headline: World trade chief wants credible China proposal.

text.p: World Trade Organisation (WTO) Director General Renato Ruggiero said on Monday he hoped to make clear in talks with Chinese officials that Beijing must come up with a new, credible proposal to win entry to the body.

"I really hope to give the sense that we have not to lose momentum and we are really waiting for a new and big credible proposal of China," Ruggiero told Reuters on the first day of a visit to Beijing.

"We'll give to the Chinese authorities the awareness that we have to build on this favourable momentum of the negotiations," he said, referring to the drawn-out talks on China's application for membership of the WTO, the successor body to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.
"So we must get from China a credible and good proposal on market access as, of course, we have to make new progess on the protocol," Ruggiero said.
China is locked in bilateral negotiations with WTO member nations on entry, with market access a particular stumbling block, and must also agree to provisions in the WTO protocol to win entry.
